aravali-residency.name: Aravali Residency
aravali-residency.details:
Fictional example hotel for the demo.
Rooms:
- Standard Room (double bed, AC, TV): ₹1,800 per night
- Deluxe Room (king bed, AC, TV, mini fridge): ₹2,800 per night
- Family Suite (2 rooms, sleeps 4): ₹4,500 per night
All rooms include breakfast (7:30 – 10:30 am). Extra bed ₹500. Children under 6 stay free.
Check-in 12 noon, check-out 11 am. Early check-in depends on availability.
Free Wi-Fi and free parking. Restaurant open 7 am – 11 pm, veg and non-veg.
Couples welcome with valid ID. Pets not allowed.
Payment: cash, UPI or card. 25% advance to confirm a booking.
Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in.
3 km from the bus stand, 6 km from the railway station. Taxi pickup ₹300.
